decisions.step_8_scope: Classify source entities against the versioned UN M49 country-or-area reference plus explicit source-aggregate overrides before computing a distribution. Use 2000 as the fixed baseline and 2024 as the endpoint for this snapshot only if at least 150 M49 country-or-area entities have non-missing observations at both endpoints. Exclude aggregates, unresolved codes, and all 2025 observations from the comparison. Recalculate and report eligible and excluded counts; never infer entity type from code shape alone.
permitted_formulas: Within-entity percentage-point change = 2024 share minus 2000 share, using the unrounded source values and linked input fact IDs.
Distribution summaries may be computed over the identical eligible M49 country-or-area cohort, with a named formula, denominator, missing-data rule, and tests.
decisions.display_policy: Shares and percentage-point changes: one decimal. Round only for display; do not calculate from rounded values. Report the cohort size and the fixed years next to every distribution.
blocked_claims: 2025 is a comparable country endpoint in this snapshot
OWID regional or income-group aggregates are countries
Internet use measures connection quality, affordability, or digital skill
A changing-coverage ranking describes a stable cohort
required_checks: Version and cite the country-code reference, validate every included code, and list excluded or unknown codes.
Prove the 2000/2024 paired-country threshold and preserve zero separately from missing.
Recheck live asset-level rights and source freshness before any draft can be approved.

decisions.step_8_scope: EU27_2020 annual percentages only. Present the four nrg_bal categories REN, REN_ELC, REN_TRA, and REN_HEAT_CL in their shared 2024 year. Within-category temporal change may compare 2021 with 2024, never 2020 with 2021 without a separate methodological analysis. Exclude 2025.
permitted_formulas: Within the same nrg_bal category, percentage-point change = 2024 percentage minus 2021 percentage, using unrounded source facts and linked input fact IDs.
decisions.display_policy: Source percentages and percentage-point differences: one decimal, calculated before rounding. Label each category and year explicitly; retain full precision in the underlying facts.
blocked_claims: These EU27-only facts support member-country rankings
The four indicators share one denominator or can be summed or averaged into a single renewable share
The 2020-2021 change is a like-for-like trend
The available 2025 values form a complete non-provisional four-category comparison
required_checks: Assert EU27_2020, freq=A, unit=PC, the exact four nrg_bal categories and all four 2024/2021 observations.
Fail on any non-empty unreviewed status flag or missing required observation.
Explain the 2021 RED I/RED II break and distinct category denominators.
Recheck live asset-level rights and source freshness before any draft can be approved.

decisions.step_8_scope: EU27_2020 only, annual frequency A, unit RCH_A_AVG, classification TOTAL, 2018-2025. Treat the values as annual-average HICP rates of change, not index levels. Use 2025 only as the latest observation in the reviewed snapshot.
permitted_formulas: Change in annual-average inflation rate, in percentage points = 2025 rate minus 2024 rate, using unrounded source facts and linked input fact IDs.
decisions.display_policy: Rates and percentage-point difference: one decimal, calculated before rounding. Say 'annual-average rate of change' on every figure or nearby label.
blocked_claims: The pack supports country or euro-area comparisons
The annual-average rate is a price index level or monthly year-on-year rate
A lower positive rate means prices fell
Adding annual rates yields cumulative price change
The EU aggregate describes the inflation experienced by an individual household
required_checks: Assert the four exact dimension values, both 2024 and 2025 facts, and no unreviewed status flag.
Use Eurostat methodology to explain the rate-versus-level distinction and the 2026 classification/base-period boundary if discussed.
Recheck live asset-level rights and source freshness before any draft can be approved.

decisions.step_8_scope: Use only the source-provided World entity OWID_WRL, 2002-2025, four separate land-cover series: forest, savannas, shrublands_grasslands, croplands. Compare the mean of 2002-2006 with the mean of 2021-2025 within each land-cover category. Do not use countries or regional aggregates in this step.
permitted_formulas: For each land-cover series and five-year window: arithmetic mean hectares = sum of its five annual values divided by five, only when all five are present.
Within-series absolute change = recent five-year mean minus early five-year mean. Relative change = 100 times that difference divided by the early mean, only when the early mean is positive.
decisions.display_policy: Area and absolute change: one decimal million hectares after conversion from hectares; relative change: whole percent. Compute before rounding and retain hectares in the evidence record. Show the two five-year windows and avoid presenting either window as a single year's observation.
blocked_claims: The four selected categories are an exhaustive total of global burned area
Burned area is fire count, intensity, emissions, damage, or individual risk
A satellite-based estimate has complete detection of all fires
Country-level or regional findings follow from the World-only calculation
required_checks: Assert OWID_WRL and all four source series are present for every year in both windows; reject missing values rather than replacing with zero.
Preserve the Global Wildfire Information System and OWID attributions and the satellite-underestimation caveat.
Recheck live asset-level rights and source freshness before any draft can be approved.

decisions.step_8_scope: No numerical analysis or drafting. The calculator workflow guide stays on hold until all live checks in the creator verification pack are performed and recorded.
blocked_claims: Calculator output is verified source data
A prepared checklist is a passed live test
required_checks: Complete the current rights, route, embed-functionality, attribution, keyboard and mobile checks for each creator asset.
Do not reuse calculator output as article evidence.

global_step_8_constraints: Do not write or publish articles, change assets or rights, change indexability, commit, or deploy.
Every derived fact must store formula name/version, input fact IDs, cohort or dimension contract, units, precision, missing/status policy, and reproducible tests.
Do not promote snapshot-based rights summaries or this analytical approval into final legal or publication approval.
Fail closed when any dimension, method, value, status, checksum, or rights precondition differs from this decision.
